item.title: STEVE MILLOY: Trump Already Blamed For Future Cancer From Venezuelan Oil
item.description: Venezuelan oil has been refined by one of the largest U.S. refineries operated by Chevron in Pascagoula, Miss. since the 1990s. item.title: KEVIN DAYARATNA And PAUL TELLER: Snow, Cold, And The Quiet Miracle Of Modern Energy
item.description: Recent winter storms did what extreme weather events often do: it revealed things most of us rarely think about. Temperatures plunged, roads iced over, thousands of flights were canceled, and schools across much of the East Coast closed.
